title: 隔壁房间的美国人：她当面无视记者提问，助手为何说她不会告诉你？
speaker: John Lee Anderson

segments.en: John Lee, you know, in your piece, the Delci Rodriguez has talked to very few reporters.
segments.zh: 约翰·李，你在文章中提到，德尔西·罗德里格斯很少接受记者采访。

segments.en: She generally dodges questions about Maduro's abduction, who are sent to the presidency and relationship with the U.S. What did you learn from talking to her? This most recent time about the
segments.zh: 她通常回避关于马杜罗被绑架、谁被派往总统职位以及与美国关系的问题。你最近一次与她交谈，对她如何应对这个职位有什么了解？

segments.en: way that she's approaching this job she's found herself in. Very good question. Well, I'm not sure I learned as much about what actually has happened as how she approaches her exercise
segments.zh: 很好的问题。嗯，我不确定我对实际发生的事情了解得更多，而是对她如何行使权力有了更多了解。

segments.en: of power. That is to say, I found her throughout our meeting, which was a very long one.
segments.zh: 也就是说，在我们漫长的会面中，我发现她……

segments.en: Very cagey whenever I brought up the subject of the Americans. And for the first time with the head of state, I found myself very keenly aware that they were looking over their shoulder or that
segments.zh: 每当我提到美国人的话题，她都非常谨慎。作为国家元首，我第一次敏锐地意识到他们似乎在提防着什么，或者有人在他们背后盯着。

segments.en: they had someone looking over their shoulder. But that, of course, is none other than the U.S.
government. In fact, just before going into to see her, I'd heard American voices, a group of Americans in the room next door to me. And when I asked her at a certain point in our meeting, I said,
segments.zh: 事实上，就在进去见她之前，我听到了美国人的声音，一群美国人在我隔壁房间。会面中我问她：

segments.en: who were those Americans that I heard next door? And she just blanked me. And one of her aides said, prompted her and said, you know the people you met with just a minute ago or just before.
segments.zh: 我隔壁听到的那些美国人是谁？她直接无视我。她的一位助手提醒她说，你刚见过的人。

segments.en: And she continued to blank me. And finally another aide said, she's not going to tell you.
segments.zh: 她继续无视我。最后另一位助手说，她不会告诉你的。
